A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RDRF dataset and DiffUR3 framework, and all supplied pages are readable. However, v1 includes supplementary Sections A–H, whereas v4 ends after the references while still referring to supplementary material. This gap limits comparison of the supplementary methods, experiments, and limitations.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark results, component ablations, a user study, and supplementary generalization, downstream-detection, and runtime experiments.

after.justification: v4 retains original benchmark results, ablations, qualitative evaluations, and the user study, and reports two additional cascaded-baseline comparisons.

M1.justification: The shared methodology retains the same restoration stage, diffusion control branch, Modulate&Gate module, Fidelity Encoder, and color correction. However, v1 Supplement B also specifies a multiple-stage-I extension with softmax gating. Its retention or revision cannot be established without v4's referenced supplement.

E1.justification: Both main texts retain RDRF training/testing, RDRF-wild, and evaluation on Qian's raindrop-only dataset. v1 Supplement E additionally evaluates downstream object detection. The missing v4 supplement prevents determining whether this additional task coverage was retained.

E2.justification: Table 3 adds UMAN+DAI and DAI+UMAN to the four existing cascaded comparators; the other main benchmark competitors remain unchanged. Section 5.3 still says there are four cascaded methods, despite the six reported in v4's table.

E3.justification: Shared settings remain unchanged, including data splits, training budgets, metrics, 50-step sampling, and the 50-image, 20-expert user study. v1's supplementary alternative-stage-I tests and sampling-step/runtime evaluations have no available v4 counterparts, preventing a complete protocol comparison.

E4.justification: The main Modulate&Gate and Fidelity Encoder ablations and color-correction comparison are retained. v1's supplement additionally contains stage-I substitution and combination tests, HSV error maps, downstream detection examples, and sampling-step sensitivity analysis. Their status in v4 cannot be established from the supplied material.

E5.justification: Neither supplied PDF reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The user study retains voting proportions without uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: Table 3 adds results for UMAN+DAI and DAI+UMAN, with PSNR values of 27.50 and 27.44 dB. DiffUR3's HyperIQA changes from 0.7043 to 0.7046; its other benchmark scores and the shared ablation scores remain unchanged. DiffUR3 still leads all six benchmark metrics. Supplementary result changes cannot be assessed.

T1.justification: Section 1 adds a sequential-compositing assumption and the nested model I=(1-A)⊙[(1-W)⊙B+W⊙Rf]+A⊙Rd, with cross-term reasoning for coupling. v1 presents the separate degradation models and asserts their interaction without this derivation. The shared method equations are unchanged.

C1.justification: Both versions retain the claims of introducing the UR3 task, the first dedicated RDRF dataset and pipeline, and state-of-the-art restoration performance. Describing DiffUR3 as an effective, qualified baseline does not change these retained scientific claims or component contributions.

C2.justification: v4 adds a substantive mechanism explanation: the raindrop coefficient also modulates the reflection component, supporting the retained coupling interpretation. Shared experimental interpretations are unchanged. Changes to v1's appendix-only computational-efficiency and dataset-size limitations remain unresolved because v4's supplement is unavailable.

D1.justification: v4 adds a project-page address and removes the abstract's promise to release code and data upon acceptance. The PDF does not establish what resources the page provides. Main-text hardware, architecture settings, preprocessing, and training details remain unchanged; supplementary details cannot be compared.

R1.justification: v4 adds citations to DEA-Net and Prompt-based test-time real image dehazing in the introduction. The related-work discussion and relationship to DiffBIR remain substantially unchanged. Reference renumbering and preprint-to-publication updates do not constitute additional research-positioning changes.

P1.justification: The shared text receives a limited introduction expansion, baseline framing, affiliation/contact updates, an acknowledgment paragraph, and reordering of the user-study discussion. Most methodological and experimental prose and the main section structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 8 gains a ground-truth panel and more display space. The user-study and color-correction figures are relocated and exchange numbers 9 and 10; Table 3 expands for two comparator rows. Running headers and figure placement also change, while the shared visual evidence is otherwise retained.

improvement.justification: The explicit coupling model, additional cascade comparisons, and ground-truth panel provide modest main-text benefits, although Section 5.3 retains an incorrect comparator count. A reliable overall judgment is prevented by the missing v4 supplement: the supplied material cannot establish whether v1's method extension, additional evaluations, and explicit efficiency limitations were retained or revised.
